title: Giraffe Ki Gardan Ka Sabse Bada Dhoka! 🦒 #shorts
idea: Explaining how a giraffe's massive 2.4-meter neck contains only 7 vertebrae—the exact same number as a human.

lines.text: Giraffe ki 2.4 meter lambi gardan mein ek zabardast raaz chupa hai!
Itni lambi gardan hone ke bawajood isme sirf 7 neck bones hoti hain!
Hairani ki baat hai ki insaan ke paas bhi wahi 7 bones hain!
Bas Giraffe ki har ek bone 28 centimeter se bhi badi hoti hai!
Itni unchai tak khoon pump karne ke liye iska dil 11 kg ka hai!
Kya aapne kabhi zoo mein Giraffe ko dekha hai? Comment mein batao!

facts.claim: Giraffes have a neck up to 2.4 m in length
Each cervical vertebra is over 28 cm long
Mammalian limit of seven cervical vertebrae
